title: Bijection on Hom sets of finite constant torsor sheaves
statement: Let $i:Y_0\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] such that its base-change functor on finite étale schemes [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category] is an equivalence. Let $M$ be a finite abelian group and $T_1,T_2$ torsors [def-sc-gm-torsor] under the constant sheaf $\underline M$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] on $Y$. Put $L=i^{-1}$ on sheaves of sets [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Then $f\mapsto L(f)$ is a bijection from $\operatorname{Hom}(T_1.\mathrm{sheaf},T_2.\mathrm{sheaf})$ to $\operatorname{Hom}(L(T_1.\mathrm{sheaf}),L(T_2.\mathrm{sheaf}))$. The maps need not preserve the torsor actions.

source.place: Tag 0A5G, final paragraph; Tag 03RV for finite representability. Read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A5G and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03RV.

proof.text: Prove local constancy using torsor_isConstant_over_of_section for an arbitrary constant AddCommGrp-valued sheaf G, specializing G to the constant coefficient sheaf: on an étale object with a section, the action gives an isomorphism with the constant coefficient sheaf. Local nonemptiness gives a trivializing étale cover. For each geometric point, choose a section over one object in the point fiber; every germ becomes its translate after passage to a common refinement. Restrict to the open fiber on which the translating locally constant function equals a fixed m. This yields a surjection from the finite group M onto the stalk, hence finite stalks. Apply finiteLocallyConstant_sets_representable to obtain finite étale representatives of the underlying set sheaves, and lift the presheaf isomorphisms through fullyFaithfulSheafToPresheaf. The local-constancy lemma generalizes the source-library isConstant_over_of_section by replacing its specified constantSheaf M with an arbitrary G and an IsConstant instance. The finite-stalk proof follows EtaleTorsorDescent. Importing that module would close the cycle through HenselianFiniteEtale and this item, so it is not imported.

Let I and I₀ include finite étale objects into their small étale sites and R=I⋙uliftYoneda, R₀=I₀⋙uliftYoneda. Apply nonempty_inverseImage_representable_iso to the constructed set-sheaf adjunction and whisker by I, obtaining c:R⋙L ≅ F⋙R₀. Since F is an equivalence and R₀ is fully faithful, c transports fullness and faithfulness to R⋙L. The inclusions are fully faithful by MorphismProperty.Comma.fullyFaithfulChangeProp; sheaf Yoneda is fully faithful by GrothendieckTopology.fullyFaithfulUliftYoneda.

For represented objects P,Q, injectivity of L.map follows by applying faithfulness of R⋙L to R.preimage f and R.preimage g, then mapping back by R. Surjectivity lifts k using R.map ((R⋙L).preimage k). Finally conjugate the source and target maps by d₁,d₂ and their images under L; the inverse identities cancel these conjugations, giving the claimed bijection. These are the two constructor branches of the Lean proof.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0A5G final paragraph and Tag 03RV; X2 repair generalizes local triviality to any constant group sheaf and uses finite stalks and lower-level set-sheaf representability. EtaleTorsorDescent cannot be imported because it reaches this item.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_torsor_pullback_hom_bijective
    [(@IsFinite ⊓ @Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}).IsStableUnderBaseChange]
    {Y Y₀ : Scheme.{u}} (i : Y₀ ⟶ Y)
    (hFE : (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback (@IsFinite ⊓ @Etale) ⊤ i).IsEquivalence)
    (M : Type (u + 1)) [AddCommGroup M] [Finite M]
    (T₁ T₂ : Sheaf.Torsor
      ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of M))) :
    Function.Bijective
      (fun f : T₁.sheaf ⟶ T₂.sheaf ↦ (Scheme.etaleSetPullback i).map f)
